text:
Maria H: heads up — seeing 4-7% east-west packet loss between rack-a (az1-rack-03) and rack-b (az1-rack-09). GPU jobs using RDMA failing with pkey errors. Jobs started ~08:12 UTC.
Aj Patel: any ToR logs? show counters?
Maria H: attaching quick snippet:
```
toR1# show interface counters ethernet 1/13
Rx Errors: 1247  Drops: 860  MTU: 9000
RDMA log: cm event: REQ_ERR pkey_mismatch retries=3
ip -s link show bond0
    RX: 1,200,000 packets  errors 0  dropped 1124
```
InfraBot: ALERT: L4-drop-rate exceeded threshold on toR1 (rack-03): 6.2% (last 5m)
Ryan C: sounds like asymmetric MTU or a bad SFP. Did we roll a config change?
Maria H: no config change in last 24h per deploy-bot.
Aj Patel: check if LACP flapping — run `ethtool -S eth0 | grep lacp` and `dmesg` for phy link errors. Also collect `show platform hardware qfp counters` on the switch.
Nate - Rackops: on it — doing physical check on rack-03 ToR. ETA 20m.
Sofia L: we should also try re-routing RDMA flows via rack-04 ToR to see if errors follow or stay local. Can we move a small test job?
Maria H: started a small allreduce test pinned to az1-r03-n[14-16] -> results: 60s window showed 0.1% loss when routed via rack-04 path.
Ryan C: ok that points to ToR/rack issue. Nate, any optical errors?
Nate - Rackops: found intermittent SFP rx_bad_blocks on port 13, laser power drift. Replacing SFP now and reseating cable.
InfraBot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2398 internal-l4-tor-flap — assigned to Nate and Aj.
Aj Patel: after SFP swap I see drop counters falling. Running RDMA sanity: `ibv_rc_pingpong -d mlx5_0` and `ibv_rc_pingpong -x 4096` for larger transfers.
Maria H: pingpong shows stable after replace, no pkey errors, retries dropped to zero. Training jobs resumed and restarted.
Ryan C: leaving this open for 1h to watch for regressions. Also adding permanent monitoring on SFP rx_errors and L4 drop-rate per ToR port.
Nate - Rackops: replaced SFP and re-seated patch panel, no further rx_bad_blocks on toR1 port13.
Maria H: confirmed production GPU jobs stabilized, failure rate back to baseline. Thanks everyone :tada:
Sofia L: let's add an MTU-drift detector and alert on asymmetric MTU across ECMP paths — RDMA is sensitive to this.
Ryan C: created follow-up task in INC-2398 to add MTU drift detector, SFP lifecycle checks, and a playbook for ToR replacement during RDMA-sensitive workloads.
Maria H: marking root cause as SFP degradation causing L4 packet drops and RDMA reconnection loops. Will close once INC-2398 auto-resolves.
